prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a hit while turning left. The patient had 25 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1467; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a collision that occurred while the patient was turning left and was struck from the side. The reported mechanism is consistent with the force involved, and the resulting wrist fracture is a typical injury for this type of impact. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the fracture, and the clinical picture supports the account given at intake. The patient also reports a minor wrist strain in the distant past that resolved completely with no lasting limitation and did not affect the present evaluation. Care was delivered over 25 visits, following a usual and expected course. Treatment intensity tapered steadily as healing progressed and function improved. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicative charges for each service rendered. Ongoing follow-up is recommended to monitor range of motion and grip strength, with return to full activity anticipated as recovery continues.
